insight: Málaga, Spain–based Freepik acquired AI image-upscaler Magnific in 2024, folding it into its generation studio.
name: Freepik
tagline: AI creative suite — generate images, video, and audio beside a vast stock library.
description: Freepik pairs its long-running stock-asset marketplace with an AI studio that bundles dozens of third-party generation models behind one subscription. Users generate images with models like Flux, its in-house Mystic, and Ideogram, plus video, upscaling, and editing tools, then drop results next to Freepik's stock photos, vectors, and templates.

modelSupport.notes: Aggregates 40+ third-party and in-house generation models in one studio.

edge: Bundles 40+ image/video models (Flux, Mystic, Ideogram) plus a huge stock-asset library behind one subscription.
pros: Free tier to try before paying
cons: Commercial rights need a paid plan

references.title: Move over Midjourney — Freepik Mystic is the most realistic AI generator
